277:t_10:5.en:
$$ランド$$
「Whoops...! Did my true self slip out?」

277:t_10:6.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「You must be joking! You'll disgrace $$ザ・ヒート$$'s name.」

277:t_10:7.en:
$$ランド$$
「That's just it... That woman who appeared at the end called me something-or-other $$ザ・ヒート$$...」

277:t_10:8.en:
$$ランド$$
「But I don't know any beauties like her...」

277:t_10:9.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「A mysterious space, a mysterious beauty... Mysteries are mysteries. Puzzling over them here won't get you beyond speculation.」

277:t_10:10.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「More importantly, I'm happy we wiped out that terrifying army.」

277:t_10:12.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「I... got so carried away that I produced 100 Z worth of $$Ｚチップ$$ myself. Naturally, I added them to the team's stock.」

277:t_10:13.en:
$$ランド$$
「I've gotta admire your obsession with $$Ｚチップ$$.」

277:t_10:14.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Of course! That's what a dimensional merchant does!」

277:t_10:15.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
(Yes... And that is our last hope.)

277:t_10:22.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「It seems the $$血塗られた眼$$ still trouble you.」

277:t_10:23.en:
$n
「It's just as I told $$アルト$$ and the others. There's nothing we can learn right now...」

277:t_10:24.en:
$n
「So I'll just deal with what's in front of me, one thing at a time.」

277:t_10:26.en:
$n
「I can deal with my own problems myself. The problem is...」

277:t_10:29.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「I wonder... You're no longer the troublesome student you used to be...」

277:t_10:30.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Why not approach her as a man and fill the emptiness in her heart...!?」

277:t_10:31.en:
$n
「I was an idiot to ask you.」

277:t_10:33.en:
$n
「If I stay here, you'll probably make me mind $$Ｄトレーダー$$.」

277:t_10:38.en:
$$スズネ$$
「They find hope in any despair... The $$いがみ合う双子$$ are rather endearing.」

277:t_10:39.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「It depends on the person. $$ガドライト・メオンサム$$ drew out his $$スフィア$$'s power through anger and resignation.」

277:t_10:40.en:
$$スズネ$$
「I don't care about a dead man. What matters is what comes next.」

277:t_10:42.en:
$$スズネ$$
「Everything has begun to move... Toward the true collapse that comes once every 120 million years...」

277:t_10:43.en:
$$スズネ$$
「When we return to Earth, the beginning of the end will come...」

277:t_10:45.en:
$$スズネ$$
「Until then, put your efforts into business.」

277:t_10:46.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Of course! So let's give it our all today, too... Business, business!」

278:t_000:2.en:
$$ＷＩＬＬ$$
「I've confirmed our position. We're near Jupiter, in the world we came from.」

278:t_000:4.en:
$$渓$$
「W-we... jumped from the galactic center to the solar system in an instant...」

278:t_000:5.en:
$$凱$$
「Ha, ha ha ha! We did it! We did it!!」

278:t_000:6.en:
$$田中司令$$
「Indeed. Whatever happened along the way, the result is something to celebrate.」

278:t_000:7.en:
$$ＷＩＬＬ$$
「Be on guard. A fleet is approaching us.」

278:t_001:0.en:
$$渓$$
「It's the $$クォーター$$ and $$ラー・カイラム$$! The $$ネェル・アーガマ$$ and $$プトレマイオス$$ are here, too!」

278:t_001:1.en:
$$田中司令$$
「This is a surprise. We've met everyone we lost in subspace here of all places...」

278:t_001:2.en:
$$Ｆ．Ｓ．$$
「They've returned to the solar system, too...」

278:t_001:3.en:
$$凱$$
「Hold on! This is way too convenient!」

278:t_001:4.en:
$$渓$$
「Y-yeah...! Even I can't just say everything worked out and leave it at that!」

278:t_001:6.en:
$$田中司令$$
「Well, there's no point getting flustered here. Let's meet up with everyone and exchange information.」

278:t_001:7.en:
$$Ｆ．Ｓ．$$
(The galactic center... Then a transfer to mysterious space... Then a return to the solar system and reunion with our allies... It's far too convenient...)
